bodyHtml: Attention JourneyLite Dayton patients: Through the end of June (2020) all patients scheduled with our nurse practitioner Dana will be virtual appointments through our HealthTrac app. These include any appointments scheduled on Tuesdays or Thursdays. All Friday appointments with the physicians will be live, in-person appointments at the Dryden Road location. Please bring a mask if you have one! Thank you.
